modmenu.descriptionTranslation.xcraft: Multiply ore drops, mob drops, XP and furnace speed. Configurable, server-side, for Fabric, NeoForge & Forge.
xcraft.midnightconfig.title: xCraft Config
Multiplies what ores drop when mined (Silk Touch is unaffected)
xcraft.midnightconfig.entityDropMultipli: Multiplies the loot dropped by mobs
xcraft.midnightconfig.xpMultiplier.toolt: Multiplies the value of experience orbs
xcraft.midnightconfig.furnaceSpeedMultip: Makes furnaces, blast furnaces and smokers cook faster
